reason: Every entry is done, cannot-occur, later, or missing-with-a-refusal that stops above its branch's first write, draw or line. The production game runs every done path: scripts/run-pet-melee-attack.mjs replays six fresh C recordings that match call for call and screen for screen, and the development sessions seed0900 and seed0103 reach the same code. The three missing entries are refusals rather than gaps, each named in missingWorkByOwner, and QUALITY.json holds the one that needs a case just outside the goal's limit. Re-verified at 8012570, the head of the correctness pass's four audit-fix commits. Those commits changed js/mhitm.js and js/uhitm.js, so the checklist no longer covered the head on its b1f11c4 stamp. Two conditions were re-read rather than re-stamped: every mattackm() arm outside the physical group still refuses, and passivemm()'s AD_ENCH arm moved from an unconditional stop to C's own guard, which entry 14 now records.

boundary.startingEvent: dogmove.c dog_move() reaches its ALLOW_M arm with an adjacent hostile on the square the pet would step into, which mon.c mon_allowflags() flags for every tame monster.
boundary.endingEvent: The screen after the defender's death line, once mon.c monkilled(), mondied() and corpse_chance() have run and makemon.c grow_up() has banked the killer's hit point. monkilled()'s line blocks at a --More-- when it is not the turn's first, so the kill's own draws land on the following key and the differential compares per step.
boundary.validInputs: Any role whose starting pet is a kitten, little dog or pony, with the pet adjacent to an ordinary hostile. The committed matrix presses spaces alone, with rest_on_space and !safe_wait so that one key both rests a move and dismisses a --More--.
boundary.observables: The to-hit roll rnd(20 + i), missmm()'s and hitmm()'s lines, mdamagem()'s d(damn,damd), mhitm_knockback()'s rn2(3) and rn2(6), passivemm()'s rn2(3) while the defender lives, monkilled()'s line, corpse_chance()'s rn2(tmp), make_corpse() and its corpse timer, grow_up()'s rnd(victim->m_lev + 1) and the mhpmax it banks, and dog_move()'s own rn2(4) for the return attack.
boundary.exclusions: Every mattackm() arm outside the AT_CLAW/AT_KICK/AT_BITE/AT_STNG/AT_TUCH/AT_BUTT/AT_TENT group: AT_WEAP, AT_HUGS, AT_GAZE, AT_EXPL, AT_ENGL, AT_BREA and AT_SPIT, with gazemm(), gulpmm(), explmm(), mswingsm() and thrwmm() unported. Inside mdamagem(), everything an AD_PHYS blow does not reach: the touch_petrifies() pre-check, the pudding clone and the AD_DGST tail. Inside passivemm(), every damage type but the empty slot's own. makemon.c grow_up()'s level gain and its !victim arm. dogmove.c dog_eat(), which the pet reaches on the turn after a kill that leaves a corpse.

sourceReview: Every branch and helper reachable between dog_move()'s ALLOW_M arm and the screen after the defender's death line was read in nethack-c/upstream/src and traced against the port: mhitm.c mattackm(), noises(), pre_mm_attack(), missmm(), hitmm(), mdamagem() and passivemm() in full; makemon.c grow_up() in full; uhitm.c mhitm_ad_phys() and shade_miss(); do_name.c mon_nam_too(); mhitu.c getmattk(), could_seduce() and mtrapped_in_pit() as already-ported callees; dogmove.c dog_move():1113-1171. Random-number order was checked call by call against six fresh C recordings and against the development sessions seed0900 and seed0103. Every stop this slice adds sits above the first write, draw or line of the branch it refuses, and each is named in the entries above. Three C expressions are ported but provably dead on every admitted path, and are marked as such in js/mhitm.js rather than deleted: the cockatrice instinct at 421-427, hitmm()'s weaponhit and silverhit at 646-650, and mdamagem()'s troll_baned() write at 1080-1081, all of which need a wielded weapon that only the refused AT_WEAP arm can supply.
